observations: Two photos show a large rectangular solar panel standing outdoors on dirt ground.
"INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP" appears as a watermark across both photos.
Other solar panels are leaning against walls in the background.
No battery, inverter, or charge controller is visible in either photo.
No readable brand label, model number, or wattage sticker is visible on the panel frame.
No new photo or video was sent after the seller's reply.

claims.evidence: Photos show a panel but quality cannot be judged remotely.
No battery appears in either photo.
No battery appears in either photo.

claims.evidence: Seller's words only; no photo or video of a test was provided.

risks.proof: Photo of the actual item being sold with a clear label.
risks.if_unproven: as a mismatched or incorrect item

risks.risk: Panel wattage, brand, and model are unreadable, so value cannot be confirmed.

risks.risk: Panel output cannot be verified without a test under sunlight.

proof_requests: Close-up of the label/sticker on the panel frame showing brand, model, and wattage.
Photo of the back of the panel.
Close-up of the solar cells to check for cracks or discoloration.
Video of the panel producing voltage and current in sunlight with a multimeter.
response.reason: No new visual evidence was sent; the seller's verbal claim of testing is not proof, so the panel remains priced at its worst case as untested and possibly non-functional.
